title: Three-clip zoo ad with a voice-over and a logo end card
vague: a 45 second ad for our zoo with a voice-over, show different animals, end on our logo

answers.logo: the name is Ridgeview Zoo, green and gold, a simple antelope mark
answers.details: open daily 9 to 5, kids under 5 free

full: A 45-second widescreen (16:9) YouTube ad for Ridgeview Zoo in three clips with a warm, friendly voice-over: lions at dawn, then penguins being fed, then giraffes at the treetops; end on a clean logo card that reads exactly 'Ridgeview Zoo' in green and gold with a simple antelope mark and the line 'Open daily 9–5 · Kids under 5 free'. The voice-over invites families to visit this weekend.
